class P(property): __slots__=("tag","__dict__")
p=P(lambda self:7)
p.tag=9
p.note="ok"
print(p.tag,p.__dict__["note"],type(p) is P,p.__doc__)

class P(property): pass
def f(self):
 "getter doc"
 return 7
p=P(f)
print(p.__doc__,p.__dict__["__doc__"],p.fget is f)
p.__doc__="changed"
print(p.__doc__)

getter doc getter doc True
changed

class P(property): pass
p=P(lambda self:7,doc="explicit")
print(p.__doc__)

class P(property): pass
class A:
 @P
 def x(self): return self.value
 @x.setter
 def x(self,value): self.value=value
a=A()
a.x=7
p=A.x
q=p.getter(lambda self:9)
print(a.x,type(p) is P,type(q) is P,q.__get__(a,A),q.__name__)

class P(property):
 def __init__(self,*args):
  print("init",len(args))
  property.__init__(self,*args)
p=P(lambda self:7)
q=p.setter(lambda self,x:None)
print(type(q) is P,q.fget is p.fget)

class P(property): pass
p=P(lambda self:7)
print(property.__init__(p,lambda self:9),p.__get__(object(),object))

class P(property): pass
p=P(lambda self:7)
q=p.getter(None)
print(type(q) is P,q.fget is p.fget)

class W(staticmethod): pass
def f(value):
 "document"
 return value
w=W(f)
w.tag=[7]
print(type(w) is W,w.__func__ is f,w.__wrapped__ is f,w.__name__,w.__doc__,w.tag[0],w.__dict__["__name__"])
cases.stdout: True True True f document 7 f

class S(staticmethod):
 def __call__(self,x): print("call"); return x+1
s=S(lambda x:x+2)
print(s(7),staticmethod.__call__(s,7))

class S(staticmethod): pass
s=S(lambda:7)
s.__dict__["__wrapped__"]=9
print(callable(s.__wrapped__))
s.__wrapped__=7

class S(super): pass
class A:
 def f(self): return 7
class B(A): pass
b=B()
s=S(B,b)
s.tag=[9]
print(type(s) is S,s.f(),s.__thisclass__ is B,s.__self__ is b,s.__self_class__ is B,s.tag[0])

class S(super): pass
class A:
 def f(self): return 7
class B(A): pass
b=B()
s=S(B)
t=s.__get__(b,B)
print(type(t) is S,t.f(),t.__get__(b,B) is t)

s.tag=7

import helper
Module=type(helper)
class M(Module): __slots__=("tag",)
m=M("named")
m.tag=7
m.x=9
print(m.tag,m.__dict__["x"],"tag" in dir(m),"__name__" in dir(m))

import helper
Module=type(helper)
class M(Module): pass
m=M("named")
m.__dir__=lambda:["custom"]
print(dir(m)==["custom"])

import helper
Module=type(helper)
class M(Module): pass
m=M("first")
m.x=7
print(Module.__init__(m,"second","doc"),m.__name__,m.__doc__,m.x)

import helper
Module=type(helper)
class M(Module):
 def __init__(self,name): self.tag=name
m=M("named")
print(m.tag,hasattr(m,"__name__"))

import helper

class M(Module): pass
m=Module.__new__(M)
print(type(m) is M,len(m.__dict__),hasattr(m,"__name__"))
